sections.title: 1. Completely Untested Files
sections.content:
All Lambda handlers lack test harnesses:

| Lambda | Routes | Key Untested Logic |
|--------|--------|--------------------|
| `planner-lambda` | ~15 | Time blocks, reflections, module pauses |
| `nutrition-lambda` | ~12 | Meal CRUD, AI meal generation, prep sessions |
| `workouts-lambda` | ~14 | Plan generation, session logging, body measurements |
| `supplements-lambda` | ~8 | Compliance tracking, schedule, inventory |
| `uploads-lambda` | — | S3 presign, OCR receipt/whiteboard import |
| `auth-middleware` | — | JWT verification, SSM secret caching |

---

sections.title: 2. Partially Tested Files — Missing Functions
3. Missing Error Handling Tests
4. Missing Integration Test Scenarios
5. Priority Ranking (Top 10)
sections.content:
| # | Gap | Why Critical |
|---|-----|--------------|
| 1 | `auth-middleware` JWT verification | Gates all API access; zero coverage |
| 2 | `planner-lambda` handler router | 15 routes, no test harness at all |
| 3 | Gemini timeout/malformed-JSON fallback | Silent failure path in production |
| 4 | Workout HealthKit conflict detection race | Concurrent writes → data corruption |
| 5 | Finances monthly projection rounding | Off-by-one on 4.33x multiplier |
| 6 | Nutrition Gemini generation failure | AI meal gen can silently 500 |
| 7 | Health hints with <7 days logged | Division-by-zero risk |
| 8 | Health → Workouts cross-lambda flow | Core product promise untested end-to-end |
| 9 | Uploads OCR receipt/whiteboard | No coverage on S3 presign + parse |
| 10 | Supplements compliance % aggregation | Aggregation math completely uncovered |

**Biggest structural gap:** Lambda handlers use a shared `validateBody` / `getUserId` / `error()` pattern from `lambdaUtils`, but that package itself has no edge-case tests — a single fix there protects all lambdas simultaneously. Start there before adding per-route tests.
